files.description: The complete EHI export documentation as PDF. A 2-page Google Doc titled 'Simplify EMR b(10) Export Format' describing the export folder structure: one C-CDA XML file per patient, plus subfolders for encounter notes (PDF/HTML) and patient documents (PDF/HTML). Extremely minimal — describes container format only, no data dictionary or field definitions.
Plain text export of the Google Doc for easy machine-readable access to the full document content.
DOCX export of the Google Doc, preserving original formatting and the embedded hyperlink to USCDI-Version-1-July-2020-Errata-Final_0.pdf.
Screenshot of the Google Doc title page showing 'Simplify EMR / Export Format' heading and document tab structure.
Screenshot of the Google Doc content page showing the full export format specification: All Patient Mode and Single Patient Mode descriptions with folder structure details.
